## Workflow Integration

`gds` connects three generative design surfaces:

<Steps>
  <Step title="Figma Code Connect">
    Every UI component is linked to its Figma component node and typed design
    variables, ensuring zero drift between Figma and production code.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Google Stitch Engine">
    Transforms text prompts into structured Material 3 screens adhering to
    `DESIGN.md` specifications and harmonic spatial grids.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Gemini Web Canvas & Nano Banana">
    Generative UI canvas with embedded `gemini-2.5-flash-image` asset slots
    matched to the primary tonal palette.
  </Step>
</Steps>

---

## DESIGN.md Specification

The `DESIGN.md` format captures visual identity, prose rationale, and token constraints for coding agents:

```yaml
# DESIGN.md
name: Google Material 3 Sovereign
colors:
  paper: "#F9F9FF"
  ink: "#1A1C1E"
  primary: "#445E91"
```
